en: So how can we now get HTMX to automatically

Well, for that, we need to adjust the
trigger
of this GET request.
Remember that the default trigger is the
most obvious event for the element on which
this attribute is added. And for an
unordered list, like for most elements,

request when we click on this element.

user event. Instead,
I wanna change it to some

that. Instead of specifying an event like
mouseenter or click here,
you can also specify specify every

But for our example here, this is all we

reload, you will see that after 5 seconds,

And then after 5 seconds, we again have them
being replaced and so on. So now HTMX is
polling for new places every 5 seconds. 5
seconds.
And of course, we can still add places from
up there. Then we'll automatically refetch
these places, but the polling mechanism will
stay active because we specified it here on
the unordered list. And we're never
replacing this unordered list item here
because when we do return it, like here when
we
added a new place to the dream places, we
perform that out-of-band swap such that we
only replace the content, the children of
this unordered list with the content defined

And that's therefore how you can set up
polling with HTMX.
